cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault; first funding may use wallet-signed CreateAccount or a native Payment to avoid public-account precreation griefing. Connected-wallet support for both remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 9998f7cb adds pure latest-ledger reserve quorum: two identical full observations are required; newer or same-sequence dissent is rejected; an older higher reserve is carried conservatively with the agreed sequence and `closed_at`. Four focused tests exist but are unrun; only scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed, with Cargo/dfx held by other work. This is local decision logic, not evidence of independent providers or live freshness. Commit 9f8eb5a7 also adds pure receipt/credit decisions, but no open/confirm endpoints, provider account quorum, atomic mutation, or admission exists. No live Horizon outcall or deposit credit is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: Commit 9998f7cb adds pure latest-ledger reserve agreement rules, with four focused unrun tests; the freshness predicate does not establish live observation freshness or provider independence. Commit 9f8eb5a7 adds pure receipt/credit decision rules, also uncompiled/unrun. No provider quorum wiring, open/confirm endpoints, or atomic state mutation exists. Credit/key/receipt/status state is dormant. Generated Candid and frontend declarations remain stale after the key setter change. cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Pure source now provides two-observation latest-ledger reserve agreement and CreateAccount/native-Payment deposit evidence decisions, including dissent rejection, attribution/replay/live-vault checks, and claim gross-plus-fee reservations. Four reserve-quorum tests are added but unrun; no Cargo/dfx verification. No provider account quorum, open/confirm endpoints, atomic state mutation, or live credit exists. WP3 remains blocked; provider independence, actual observation freshness/oracle, and testnet/frontend integration remain open. No live provider/oracle proof, XLM admission, or deployment is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: The pure deposit-evidence helper reserves unsettled claim gross plus fee, but does not implement live claim settlement or payout. Transaction-status transport preserves fee and normalized not-found evidence in source; its 39 policy tests remain unrun. No Cargo/dfx test or live call has verified transport or claim reservations. Provider independence and live evidence freshness remain unresolved, so WP4 stays blocked. The XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not an XLM-specific required gate. Reserve/oracle checks, testnet, frontend, and release remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission.

cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. Multi-operation receipt/status and frontend guard changes have not been compiled. Full XLM frontend integration and supported deposit/withdrawal/claim flows remain open.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these commits. Commit 9998f7cb adds pure latest-ledger reserve quorum (two identical full observations; reject newer or same-sequence dissent; carry older higher reserve conservatively) with four focused tests that remain unrun. Only scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed; no Cargo/dfx run due shared heavy hold. This local rule does not prove provider independence or live freshness. No endpoint integration or atomic mutation exists; status parser's 39 tests also remain unrun. Remaining blockers include provider independence, actual reserve/oracle freshness, full deposit credit and claim settlement, frontend/testnet, and release. WP3/WP4/release remain blocked; no live provider/oracle proof, admission, or deployment.
